chapter: Family, Margaret's story and Eutris's memories
title: Brothers and sisters
summary: He had six sisters and one brother; names of siblings are pieced together with Mrs. H.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: We started to talk the last time we were here about your early childhood. You told us about you being born in
Social Circle, Georgia. I have to remember that. How many brothers did you have? Did you have any brothers and sisters?
Yeah, I had 6 sisters.
Any of them play music?
I told you I couldn't hear so good.
Any of your sisters play music?
Oh yeah.
What did they play? Piano?
One plays piano and the one up in the Bronx plays the guitar.
How about brothers? Do you have any brothers?
...One brother. He had a band in Cleveland, but he stopped.
What's his name?
Bob Higginbotham.
Yes, he's out in Cleveland with my sister.
How about your sisters? What are the sisters' names?
Five now.
What are their names?
Annie May's here.
Eutris, that's the one that's mentioned in his biography.
Eutris is in Cleveland. Emma is in -
Tennessee. She's in Chattanooga, Tennessee.
Sure is. I don't know how to keep up with them.
